Bryan Rasmussen looks specifically at XPath and demonstrates how it can be used alongside CSS to query elements.

entry.title: Effectively Monitoring Web Performance
entry.summary: There are lots of tips for [improving your website performance](https://www.debugbear.com/blog/improve-website-performance?utm_campaign=sm-10). But even if you follow all of the advice, are you able to maintain an optimized site? And are you targeting the right pages? Matt Zeunert outlines an effective strategy for web performance optimization and explains the roles that different types of data play in it.
